    by_cases hA : A ∈ P

    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hmissing A hA
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAcV⟩ := hmissing Aᶜ hAc
    have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
        by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
        · have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
          rw [hAU] at hx
          exact hx
        · have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by
            simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff]
          have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxAc, hxV⟩
          rw [hAcV] at hx
          exact hx
      · simp
    exact (hPP U hU V hV) hUV

    by_cases hA : A ∈ P

    by_cases hAc : Aᶜ ∈ P

    have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
        by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
        · have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
          rw [hAU] at hx
          exact hx
        · have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by
            simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff]
          have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxAc, hxV⟩
          rw [hAcV] at hx
          exact hx
      · simp
    exact (hPP U hU V hV) hUV
